Is Selling Feet Pics Legal?

A normal photo of an adult's feet does not become a crime because a buyer has a fetish. The harder questions are age, consent, the shop's contract, and whether you report the money.

Dark-Ero editorialUpdated 2026-11-1018+

At a glance

US adults can generally sell lawful photos of their own feet.

A shop can still ban a payout, a chat, or an off-platform payment that no statute mentions.

Anyone under 18 stays out of this market, including with a parent's permission.

Key takeaways

  • Create only what you have the right to sell, and get consent if another adult is in the frame.
  • Platform ID checks are normal, and a buyer who asks for your passport or password is not.
  • Plain feet photos are often treated as non-explicit, and explicit sets can pull in extra record-keeping.
  • US income from digital sales is generally taxable even when no form arrives.
  • This is general information, not a substitute for a lawyer or a tax preparer in your state.

In the United States, adults can generally sell lawful photos and videos of their own feet. The buyer's fetish does not, by itself, turn a lawful picture into an illegal one.

The longer legal pass, with the record-keeping notes, is is selling feet pics legal. Laws and shop rules move, so treat both pages as a map and not as advice for your case.

If you need a decision for your state, talk to a qualified attorney or a tax professional there. A blog cannot see your facts.

Disclosure: Dark-Ero is independent, with no affiliate link on this page. Adults 18+ only.

Three different questions

People mix up whether the content may be sold at all, whether a named shop will allow it and pay out, and whether the income has to be reported. All three can be true at once, or only the first.

A registered platform, a card processor and an ID check can all be in place while a statement, a leak or a fake login still causes damage. Legal permission does not make the work invisible.

Age and consent

You must be an adult. Do not create, request, sell or distribute sexualized content involving anyone under 18, or under a higher age of majority where that applies.

A parent's permission does not change that. Minors do not belong in this market, as sellers or as people in the frame.

Sell work you made and have the right to distribute. Another creator's feet pics are not yours to upload, and another adult in your photo needs their consent plus whatever ID process the shop requires.

Keeping your face out of the public files is common, and it does not cancel the age check or the tax file. Shops may still hold a government ID in private, which the FeetFinder review describes for that marketplace.

Our FeetFinder review is the fee and payout version of the same point. A buyer who asks you to send the passport or a login code is running a scam, not a verification.

That pattern is laid out in how to sell feet pics without getting scammed. Start every real ID check from an account you opened yourself.

Shop rules are not criminal law

Plain photos of adult feet are often treated as non-explicit fetish content, and each shop draws its own line. If a set becomes sexually explicit under that shop's rules, extra age-record duties can apply, including the US 2257-style expectations many adult terms already copy.

The directory page that names those record-keeping duties is our 2257 compliance note. Read the seller agreement on every site you actually use, because the contract is the rule you can be banned under.

A site can require a paid plan, set a payout minimum, ban off-platform payments, or reject a file that is still lawful. Breaking the terms can cost the earnings and the account when no statute was broken.

Keep the chat and the payment on the shop that holds the order. The setup for that habit is in our sell feet pics guide.

The money is still income

In the US, money from selling digital content is generally taxable. A missing form does not create an exemption for small amounts or for a stage name.

The filing mechanics for one marketplace are in our FeetFinder taxes note. It is educational, and it is not a CPA.

The source version of that filing note is FeetFinder taxes. Keep your own record of sales, fees and costs from the first payout.

Copies, scams and other countries

Buyers can copy a digital file, and non-consensual redistribution can raise separate issues under state law. None of that makes the original sale illegal, and it does mean you run the work like a small business with boundaries.

US norms do not travel. Sellers in Britain should read how to sell feet pics in the UK before they copy a US answer.

Our how to sell feet pics in the UK page is the Dark-Ero cut of the same HMRC questions. The allowance and the filing dates are the part that surprises people.

Australia has its own income rules, covered in sell feet pics in Australia. A US page will not tell you what the ATO expects.

The shops themselves live under feet marketplaces when you are ready to compare fees. Pick the contract you can live with before you shoot a catalogue.

Our how to sell feet pics without getting scammed page is the buyer-trick list. Do not treat a social post that flashes a balance as either legal advice or an income forecast.

Verdict

For an adult selling lawful photos of their own feet, the US position is generally that the sale is allowed. Age, consent, the shop's contract and tax still sit on top of that.

You can often stay pseudonymous to buyers while the platform and the tax authority still know who you are. This is general information, not legal advice, and your state can add rules a national page will miss.

FAQ

Is it legal to sell feet pics in the US?

Adults can generally sell lawful photos of their own feet, and the buyer's fetish does not by itself make that illegal. Age, consent, shop terms and tax still apply, and this is not legal advice.

Can someone under 18 sell if a parent agrees?

No. Do not involve minors in this market as sellers or as people in the photos, even with a parent's permission.

Do I have to show my face for the sale to be legal?

Face-out selling does not decide legality on its own. You can often hide your face from buyers while the shop still requires a private identity check.

Is moving a sale off the app illegal?

An off-platform payment can be lawful in the abstract and still break the shop's terms, drop the dispute record, and raise the scam risk. Prefer the checkout the site requires.

Do I owe tax on feet pic sales?

US income from this work is generally taxable, including small and part-time amounts, even when no form arrives. Keep records and ask a tax professional if you are unsure how to file.

Do these rules apply in the UK or Australia?

No, those countries have their own criminal, platform and tax rules. Read the UK and Australia guides rather than assuming a US page covers them.
